title: Retention Mathematics: Which Player Roles Should Sunrisers Hyderabad Protect?
dek: Which players should Sunrisers Hyderabad protect when the retention window opens? Comparing retained players with auction signings shows what each route has returned.
excerpt: Since 2018, Sunrisers Hyderabad's retained players have returned more contribution per crore than their auction signings. Retention is a bet on continuity; here is how it has paid.

sections.heading: The Retention Bet
body: Retention locks in a known quantity at a fixed price before the auction. It protects a core and saves bidding wars, but it spends a large share of the purse before the market has opened.
Since 2018, retained players have taken {{ev:ret-share}} of Sunrisers Hyderabad's recorded spend across {{ev:ret-n}} player-seasons.

sections.heading: What Retention Returned
body: Retained players returned {{ev:ret-per}} tempo runs above average per crore; auction signings returned {{ev:ret-aper}}. {{ev:ret-played}} of retained player-seasons saw action, against {{ev:ret-aplayed}} for auction signings.

sections.heading: Which Roles to Protect
body: Retention is most valuable for roles the auction rarely supplies at a fair price: an elite death bowler, a wicketkeeper who bats in the top order, or a spinner who controls the middle overs.
For SRH, the retention list should be drawn from the scarce roles first and the famous names second.

sections.heading: Retention Prices Are Not Market Prices
body: Retention prices are set by league rules and slot values, not by bidding, so comparing them with auction prices is not like for like.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Retain for Scarcity, Not Fame
body: Sunrisers Hyderabad's retained players have returned more per crore than auction signings since 2018. Retention should be reserved for roles the auction cannot reliably refill.
The role-scarcity analysis in this series identifies which roles those are.

methodology: Contribution is tempo runs above average (tRAA): batting runs above what an average batter would score from the same balls in the same season and phase, plus bowling runs saved against the average bowler in the same season and phase. Wickets and dismissals are not valued in this version. Prices come from CricField squad lists (₹ crore = 100 lakh). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine.
